summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a material event: a cash dividend payment schedule. The Board resolved to pay a total cash dividend of ARS 39,999,772,000 in three equal installments of ARS 13,333,257,333.33 each, payable between July 1-15, August 1-15, and September 1-15, 2026. This follows approval at the Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting on April 28, 2026. No advisor or recommendation is mentioned. The filing is a routine dividend schedule with no special-situation elements beyond a significant capital return. Investors should monitor currency and regulatory timing in Argentina.
